narrative.overview: An operating interface for a person reviewing rentals in daylight on a phone or laptop. Real source photography leads; compact Dutch labels make cost uncertainty and saved decisions understandable.

rules.name: The Known Is Not All-In Rule
rules.body: A strong price value is always adjacent to the known-monthly qualifier and its all-in caveat, never treated as a marketing headline.

dos: Do preserve the property-profile mobile view and desktop list/detail structure.
Do keep complete descriptions and explicit unknown facts accessible.
Do reserve space outside the reading viewport for decision/navigation controls.
donts: Don't turn the app into metric cards, dating scores or a marketing landing page.
Don't imply a source photo is current or licensed for redistribution without evidence.
Don't put development briefs, private profile data or worker secrets into browser assets.

Don't use decorative/useless accordions or disclosures. Dropdowns only serve genuine selection; never hide a trivial source message or profile explanation behind a control. This is an explicit durable user rule.
